Question: In the expression \((\underline{\phantom{x}} \times \underline{\phantom{x}}) + (\underline{\phantom{x}} \times \underline{\phantom{x}})\) each blank is to be filled in with one of the digits \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) or \(4,\) with each digit being used once. How many different values can be obtained?
